typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DynamicFileName as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FullPath as string (),
	InboundPath as string (),
	OutboundPath as string (),
	OutputFileName as string (),
	SheetName as string (),
	SheetRange as string (),
	SuccessEmail as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Referencing Object Name} as string,
		{ERDB SYNONYM TABLE FUNCTION S} as string,
		{Report ID} as string,
		SERVER as string,
		{Tidal Job Group / SSRS Managed } as string,
		{Job or Subscription Calendar} as string,
		{Job or Subscription Start Time} as string,
		{Fines Sanctions} as string,
		Frequency as string,
		{Due to Customer Regulatory} as string,
		{Due to the state} as string,
		Market as string,
		{Team Ownership} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Subject Area} as string,
		{Report Type} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelFileonOutofSync
ExcelFileonOutofSync derive({Copy of Frequency} = Frequency,
		{Copy of Status} = Status,
		{Copy of Market} = Market,
		{Copy of SERVER} = SERVER) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Due_to_the_state as string,
		Report_ID as string,
		Job_or_Subscription_Calendar as string,
		Due_to_Customer_Regulatory as string,
		ERDB_SYNONYM_TABLE_FUNCTION_S as string,
		Tidal_Job_Group___SSRS_Managed as string,
		Report_Type as string,
		Market as string,
		SERVER as string,
		Referencing_Object_Name as string,
		Team_Ownership as string,
		Job_or_Subscription_Start_Time as string,
		Frequency as string,
		Fines_Sanctions as string,
		Subject_Area as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Status = {Copy of Status},
		Due_to_the_state = {Copy of Due to the state},
		Report_ID = {Copy of Report ID},
		Job_or_Subscription_Calendar = {Copy of Job or Subscription Calendar},
		Due_to_Customer_Regulatory = {Copy of Due to Customer Regulatory},
		ERDB_SYNONYM_TABLE_FUNCTION_S = {Copy of ERDB SYNONYM TABLE FUNCTION S},
		Tidal_Job_Group___SSRS_Managed = {Copy of Tidal Job Group / SSRS Managed},
		Report_Type = {Copy of Report Type},
		Market = {Copy of Market},
		SERVER = {Copy of SERVER},
		Referencing_Object_Name = {Copy of Referencing Object Name},
		Team_Ownership = {Copy of Team Ownership},
		Job_or_Subscription_Start_Time = {Copy of Job or Subscription Start Time},
		Frequency = {Copy of Frequency},
		Fines_Sanctions = {Copy of Fines Sanctions},
		Subject_Area = {Copy of Subject Area})) ~> LoadintoDataExchangetable
